title: The Eye of the Bedlam Bride
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: A later book in the Dungeon Crawler Carl series, in which a man and his former pet cat are forced to survive a deadly game show played for alien audiences. This installment continues their climb through ever stranger levels.
readIf: you already love the series and want more of its blend of black humour, gore and loyal friendship.
skipIf: you haven't read earlier books or dislike graphic violence and crude humour.

pairings.reason: Another game-like world with pop culture jokes, rewards and levels, though far gentler.
Same absurd, mocking take on a hostile universe, with an ordinary person caught in the middle.
A similarly nerdy, funny sci-fi with a protagonist whose odd circumstances become strangely lovable.
